units: <cite ref="Mishnah Sanhedrin 5:3">Ib. 3</cite> <he>בש׳</he> (sub <cite ref="U01645"><he>שעות</he></cite>) at seven hours of the day.
Ab. V, 7. Lam. R. introd. (R. Josh. 2) ש׳ מש׳ seven times seven; a. v. fr.—בנות ש׳, ברת ש׳, v. בַּת I a. בְּרַת I.—Esp. שִׁבְעָה (sub. ימים) Shib ah, the seven days of mourning for a near relative.
<cite ref="Moed Katan 20a:2">M. Kat. 20ᵃ</cite>, v. <cite ref="U01390"><he>שְׁלֹשָׁה</he></cite>; a. fr.—
Y. M. Kat. III, 82ᶜ; v. שָׁמַר.—Pl. שִׁבְעִים seventy.
<cite ref="Mishnah Sanhedrin 5:5">Snh. V, 5</cite> <he>עד ש׳ ואחד</he> (add to the members of the court,) until they number seventy-one.
<cite ref="Avodah Zarah 11b:3">Ab. Zar. 11ᵇ</cite> <he>אחת לש׳ שנה</he> once every seventy years; a. v. fr.
